description: Short texts (zonos3.tts.short_text; the request field short_text, default auto): a text of a few words is generated under LACI as the text, the pause marker (0.5 s) and its language's filler sentence (fillers: per server language, with the space that joins it to the marker, none for the unspaced languages), and cut once the reading position reaches the filler, so only the text is kept. A text is short when it has at most max_words whitespace-separated words and its text tokens times max_ratio[1] are at most its filler's times max_ratio[0]. cut: the first frame the silence classifier calls silent, searched from lookback frames before the reading reached the filler, with at least min_voiced non-silent generated frames up to it; none within max_frames frames of the reading reaching the filler is a run-on (the take ran into the filler), regenerated as a fresh take at most max_retries times, then cut where the reading reached the filler. silence: a codes-only classifier of the codec's frames (lingua apps.zonos.start_token silence_frames_v1, int8-quantized): a frame is silent when the sum of weights[k][code_k] over its codebooks exceeds threshold; a frame with a code outside the codebook (EOA, pad) is not. weights: base64 int8 [n_codebooks][codebook_size], row-major.
